claims.statement: For a single event, branch inclusion and ignore keys are mutually exclusive. Mixed patterns use the inclusion key, and a negative pattern requires a positive pattern. Later negative matches exclude and later positive matches re-include; the PR example matches target releases branches while excluding alpha suffixes. These example names are not adopted branch naming policy.

Workflow name controls the Actions-tab display; omitting name displays the workflow's path relative to repository root. A display label is not immutable workflow identity, successful execution or enforcement evidence.
